text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After our outing, I walked Ines Fuujin over to the amusement park where she was working her part-time job today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
You worry way too much, Trainer!
It's still daylight out, so you really didn't need to walk me home.
choice_data_list: It's kind of like an extension of going out.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well thanks anyway!
Alright, time to do my best cleaning!

text_block_list.name: Shift Leader
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Ines-chan!
Thank goodness you came early...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yaho-yaho, Leader!
What's got you in such a rush?

text_block_list.name: Shift Leader
text_block_list.text:
We're a bit short-staffed, so
we had to shuffle stations around on the fly.
Ines-chan, you're on haunted house duty!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: A-A haunted house...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin stood frozen, her expression tense.
Come to think of it, I believe she isn't very good with scary things...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm fine, totally fine!
A haunted house is nothing to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having said that,
she really doesn't look like she's doing fine.
I'm still worried. In this situation—

text_block_list.name: Shift Leader
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having changed into casual clothes and arrived at the haunted house where she worked,
Ines Fujin seemed a little displeased. That was because—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, you really worry too much!
The boss said it was okay, so it's fine, but wanting to observe my part-time job...?"
choice_data_list: Sorry, but I was worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Well, having an extra pair of hands
does help, though.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
This haunted house is closed right now due to a mechanical breakdown.
None of the other staff are here right now either.
So make sure to help clean up properly, okay!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, I'll teach you the secret to cleaning!
First, you dust from the top down—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clank!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Nyah!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...O-Oh, is that all.
I just tripped over the vacuum cleaner cord...
Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Phew! Guess I'm pretty much done.
Feels like I'm way more tired than usual, though... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Geez, why's there a rag under the sofa?
Did I forget to put it away...? Hup!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Slide...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? 
This isn't a rag, it's a bandage...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Looking closely, a mummy doll was lying
under the sofa, as if staring up at Ines Fujin――"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Waaaah?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, save meee~!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Good work out there...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she managed to finish cleaning, Ines Fujin looks utterly exhausted.
I'd like to say something encouraging, but—
choice_data_list: If it's impossible, it's okay to just say it's impossible.
If it's too much, it's totally okay to say so, you know.
Got to see a rare reaction.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though she managed to finish cleaning, Ines Fujin looks utterly exhausted.
I'd like to say something encouraging, but—
choice_data_list: If it's impossible, it's okay to just say it's impossible.
If it's too much, it's totally okay to say so, you know.
Got to see a rare reaction.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...I guess I really was being stubborn...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
My shift supervisor at work,
you know, they always adjust my hours
whenever I have training.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
So, I was hoping I could return the favor
in times like this, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "If you weren't around, Trainer, I might've actually caused trouble instead."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...You're right! When we need help, we should accept it.
And the kindness we receive is――

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'll repay you in the race!
That's what makes me, me, right?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever responsible, Ines Fujin seems to have
turned today's events into even greater passion
for her upcoming races!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're enjoying this, aren't you!
Hey now~, stop teasing me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Still, I really showed you
a lot of my pathetic side today!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: "Hey Trainer, I'd really appreciate it if you kept what happened today a secret from everyone. It's just way too embarrassing~..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that no matter how pathetic she looked,
I would keep it a secret. Hearing that...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I wonder?
You might not get to see my pathetic side anymore, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Still, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin smiled gently.
It seemed their bond of trust
had deepened once more...!
